title: Among leagues in the 2015/2016 season that hosted at least one match ending
question: Among leagues in the 2015/2016 season that hosted at least one match ending in a draw, find the one with the highest total number of goals scored across all its matches where at least one team scored 4 or more goals. Return only the league name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT L."XCL_005"
FROM League AS L
INNER JOIN Match AS M ON L."XCL_003" = M."XCL_008"
WHERE M."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
  AND (M."XCL_015" >= 4 OR M."XCL_016" >= 4)
  AND L."XCL_003" IN (
    SELECT M2."XCL_008"
    FROM Match AS M2
    WHERE M2."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
      AND M2."XCL_015" = M2."XCL_016"
  )
GROUP BY L."XCL_003", L."XCL_005"
ORDER BY SUM(M."XCL_015" + M."XCL_016") DESC
LIMIT 1
